utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m probably going to be a little late, but could you help keep an eye on the tool table and point folks to the sign-in sheet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll keep an eye on the tool table and point people to the sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—just tell me where to drop things off and what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. I’ll check the drop-off details and the current list, then I’ll send you exactly what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the drop-off spot and the updated list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll make a quick list and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be a big help—I'm mostly worried about sorting the supplies and making sure we have enough boxes and labels.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the boxes and labels. Just tell me how many you need, and I’ll track them down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any more tools or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for Saturday. I’m not sure yet on tools, but a few more volunteers would be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can help with volunteers. I’ll ask a couple neighbors and let you know if we need any specific tools too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear—I've got a drill and a set of screwdrivers I can lend if anyone needs them. I’ll swing by and see what’s on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Gus—I'll let folks know you’ve got tools to lend. Come by the table and we’ll see what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word right away. We should get a nice little turnout for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thank you, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye on the spot and make sure folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know to head your way and bring whatever they can fix up. We’ll make this drive count!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you handle the flyers and the donation drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can handle the flyers and the donation drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring requests.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — that helps a lot. I’ll keep it simple and send folks your way with repair requests.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — send them my way and I’ll keep track of everything. We’ll make sure the requests stay organized and easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. A clear list and a simple drop-off time would help folks a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll put together a clear list and pick a simple drop-off time for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, if you tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I could use help sorting the tools and checking what’s still broken.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can sort the tools and take a look at what’s still broken. Just point me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—do you want me to check who still needs details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks — if you can check who still needs details, I can follow up with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who still needs details and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together a repair drive and wanted to invite you—could really use your help if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, sorry I’m late to this—I'd be glad to help. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks, Dane—if you can bring a screwdriver set, some zip ties, and maybe a power strip, that’d be a huge help. I’ll send you the details and time as soon as I’ve got them nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Rey. First, I’d like the porch light checked, then the loose step on the front walk, and after that we can see if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll check the porch light first, then take a look at that loose step.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school pickup and drop-off, so just tell me what time the repair drive needs us.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Faye — I’m thinking we start around 3:30 and keep it going until 6. I’ll send you the exact lineup once I confirm the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 to 6 works for me — I can juggle pickup and then head over once school’s wrapped. Send the lineup when you have it, and I’ll fit my part around that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep the plan moving and share the details with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll pass it along and help keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring a few tools by for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m most worried about power tools and extension cords—we’ll also need a place to plug in, so I should check what the garage can handle.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a couple of power tools and a heavy-duty extension cord, and I’ll check the garage outlets with you if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening and what time it starts. Just tell me the location details, and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. I’ll send you the location and start time as soon as I have the final details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — just send me the final location and start time when you have them, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — when is the repair drive happening, and do you need any help getting things organized?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I don’t have the date pinned down yet, so I want to confirm the details before I say for sure. If you’re free to help, I’d really appreciate it once I’ve checked the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — just let me know the date once you’ve confirmed it, and I can help organize things then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we still need screws, a couple of hammers, and some strong tape if you have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring screws and strong tape, and I’ll see if I can borrow an extra hammer too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little behind, but I think it’s coming up soon and folks are still gathering supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — do you know if they need any specific supplies yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure the repair drive is still happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, as far as I’ve heard, it’s still on. I’ll let you know if I hear any change.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — you’re sure it hasn’t been canceled, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t heard much new yet, but I’m still keeping an eye on it. If I learn anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit foggy on the details, Leo, but I’m happy to help once we sort out what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — let’s list the broken stuff first, then we can figure out who needs tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Leo. Tell me what’s broken, and I’ll help track down the tools or parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll bring a screwdriver and some masking tape?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ll bring a screwdriver and masking tape.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are clear first. If we can sort the route and drop-off plan, that’d help me feel better about it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll sort out the route and pickup/drop-off plan and send you the details first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — once you send the route and pickup/drop-off details, I’ll feel much better about joining.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara — I’m getting the repair drive list organized and will keep it moving. If you have any homes or jobs to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send over any homes or jobs I hear about. I’m glad you’re keeping it moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still sorting through the list, honestly. I think the porch light and the loose gate are the main things, but I should check again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—can you confirm those two and let me know if anything else should be added?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s going on—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly I’m just lining up who can bring tools and who can help haul things. If you’re free, I’d love for you to stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can stop by and help haul things. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, though I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s plenty, Uli—quiet help still counts. I’ll keep your name out of it and let you know the basics as things come up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details. Did you hear when it’s supposed to start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, Nell, but I’ll keep an ear out. If I hear the start time, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate that. I’ll wait to hear from you and keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: If you’ve got a drill or a good screwdriver set, that’d be a huge help. I can swing by and grab them whenever’s easiest for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ve got a screwdriver set you can borrow. Swing by later today and grab it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s needed for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m pretty sure they need basic tools, a few replacement parts, and some volunteers to sort donations. I can double-check and let you know if I’m missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help. I’d like to wait for the confirmed list before I start.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — please check the shed and the garage first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the shed and garage now, then let you know what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s sometime after school, but I may have missed the exact time. Let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — just let me know when you find the time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive invites now—want me to add you to the list and swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, please add me to the list — I’d be glad to help out. Swing by whenever works for you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and stop by soon with the details. Thanks, Sam; I’m glad to have you helping out!
